summary.text: Steve West is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 27, serving since 2015. The legislature's profile lists West as chair of the Senate Education Committee. The profile name is Stephen West.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Stephen West was born on April 28, 1970, and is a self-employed cattle farmer and real estate attorney.
The profile lists the ownership of Kentucky Prime Realty, a graduation from Grant County High School, study at Eastern Kentucky University, and a J.D. from Northern Kentucky University.
